description: Validate a CRP 1.1 (Ed25519) Compliance Receipt issued by ANOTHER agent-memory server using that server's published public key — no shared secret (the federation primitive). Checks signature, expiry, and required caveats. Pass `receipt` (object or JSON string) and `public_key` (inline PEM or a file path; the issuer gets theirs via `agent-memory export-pubkey`).

public_key.description: Issuer's Ed25519 public key · inline PEM or a file path.

receipt.description: The Compliance Receipt to validate (object or JSON string).

required_caveats.description: Caveats that must be present (each {type, value}).

name: validate_receipt
